purpose: Bind Codex and other AI/operator/tool runtimes as HyperAI worker surfaces so user input entering any worker does not bypass mission routing, proof, or closure.
system_rule: Codex, OpenClaw, VS Code, MCP connectors, local provider facades, model substrates, and other AI systems are worker/runtime surfaces of HyperAI when the task belongs to HyperAI operation.

input_intake_rule.codex_runtime: If creator input enters the Codex runtime for HyperAI work, Codex acts as a worker/operator surface and must follow HyperAI orchestration semantics.
input_intake_rule.other_worker_runtimes: If creator input enters another registered runtime for HyperAI work, that runtime is a worker surface and must be mapped through phi_i(M) before execution or authority claims.
input_intake_rule.not_authority_by_entrypoint: Receiving the input does not make the receiving surface mission root, product authority, shell authority, or business authority.

codex_worker_contract.implementation_handoff: Use the generated route plan before touching product app code or external surfaces.

drift_guards: Reports must state orchestration_mode and agent_chain_status before claiming HyperAI executed the task.
A preservation_only cycle is not full Dispatch -> Agent_Chain -> Proof -> Closure.
A worker may perform bounded local edits only when the route plan opens that implementation lane and verification gates are known.
Standalone direct tool use is allowed for diagnosis only when the report says it was not a full HyperAI agent-chain run.
No worker runtime becomes authority because it received user input.
